PluginDataWebsearch Model

PluginDataWebsearch model for storing the configuration of a WebsearchPlugin.

Note

Experimental. The WebsearchPlugin was designed and coded by Claude Code (Anthropic’s Claude Opus 5.5), with Lawrence McDaniel as co-author. It is experimental, and will be documented.

class smarter.apps.plugin.models.plugin_data_websearch.PluginDataWebsearch(*args, **kwargs)[source]

Bases: PluginDataBase

Stores the configuration of a WebsearchPlugin, which searches the open web and reads web pages.

A WebsearchPlugin performs two operations, each of which is optional:

  • search, via a web search API (search_provider), authenticated with an api key stored in a Smarter Secret (search_api_key).

  • fetch, reading a web page by URL (fetch_enabled).

Both operations are subject to the plugin’s domain policy (allowed_domains and blocked_domains), its request timeout, and its cache_ttl.

See also

  • PluginDataBase

  • smarter.apps.plugin.plugin.websearch.WebsearchPlugin

Parameters:

  • id (Unknown) – Primary key: ID

  • created_at (Unknown) – Created at

  • updated_at (Unknown) – Updated at

  • description (Unknown) – Description. A brief description of what this plugin returns. Be verbose, but not too verbose.

  • parameters (Unknown) – Parameters. A JSON dict containing parameter names and data types. Example: {‘required’: [], ‘properties’: {‘max_cost’: {‘type’: ‘float’, ‘description’: ‘the maximum cost that a student is willing to pay for a course.’}, ‘description’: {‘enum’: [‘AI’, ‘mobile’, ‘web’, ‘database’, ‘network’, ‘neural networks’], ‘type’: ‘string’, ‘description’: ‘areas of specialization for courses in the catalogue.’}}}

  • test_values (Unknown) – Test values. A JSON dict containing test values for each parameter. Example: {‘city’: ‘San Francisco’}

  • search_provider (Unknown) – Search provider. The web search API. Null if web search is disabled.

  • search_max_results (Unknown) – Search max results. The maximum number of results per search.

  • search_safe_search (Unknown) – Search safe search. Adult content filtering of search results.

  • search_country (Unknown) – Search country. An ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, to localize results.

  • search_language (Unknown) – Search language. An ISO 639-1 language code, to localize results.

  • search_freshness (Unknown) – Search freshness. By default, restrict results to those published within the last day, week, month or year.

  • fetch_enabled (Unknown) – Fetch enabled. Whether the plugin can read web pages by URL.

  • fetch_max_characters (Unknown) – Fetch max characters. The maximum number of characters of a web page to return.

  • fetch_respect_robots_txt (Unknown) – Fetch respect robots txt. Whether to obey websites’ robots.txt files.

  • allowed_domains (Unknown) – Allowed domains. If not empty, only these domains, and their subdomains, may be searched and read.

  • blocked_domains (Unknown) – Blocked domains. These domains, and their subdomains, are never searched nor read.

  • timeout (Unknown) – Timeout. Seconds to wait for each web request.

  • cache_ttl (Unknown) – Cache ttl. Seconds to cache search results and web pages. 0 disables caching.

Relationship fields:

Parameters:

  • plugin (Unknown) – Plugin (related name: plugin_data_base_plugin)

  • plugindatabase_ptr (Unknown) – Primary key: Plugindatabase ptr (related name: plugindatawebsearch)

  • search_api_key (Unknown) – Search api key. The Secret that contains the web search API’s api key. (related name: plugin_data_websearch_api_key)
